import * as ARA3D from '../src/index'; import { showFilter } from './filterPanel.js'; import * as THREE from 'three'; async function runExample() { const viewer = new ARA3D.Viewer(); const loader = new ARA3D.BimOpenSchemaLoader(); console.time('Loading .bos file'); const bimData = await loader.load('/ara3d-webgl/rac_basic_sample_project-2025.bos'); console.timeEnd('Loading .bos file'); let group = bimData.ThreeGeometry; viewer.add(group); const catToInstances = bimData.Query.CategoryToInstances(); let first = true; function updateVisible(map) { if (first) { first = false; return; } const instances = []; const ghostMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x88aaff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.1, roughness: 0.8, metalness: 0.0, depthWrite: false, }); for (let [ name, checked ] of map) { const list = catToInstances.get(name); if (checked) { for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) instances.push(list[i]); } else { for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) { const instance = { ...list[i], material: ghostMaterial }; instances.push(instance); } } } const newGroup = bimData.rebuildGeometry(instances); viewer.remove(group); group = newGroup; viewer.add(group); } console.time("Creating filter"); showFilter( 'Category', catToInstances, (keys, map) => updateVisible(map) ); console.timeEnd("Creating filter"); } runExample();
